title: 第2301章 三重天外天的禁制布置第2300章 洞府内真正的宝物
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【仅仅是黑鳞的使用，这股力量就已经比你在修为低微时所使用的生命降神得来的提升还要大，且龙神虚甲的使用时间不短，足以支撑你完成一场完整的战斗。而如此好用的东西，自是能够得到你的极大重视，恨不能多几枚黑鳞供你使用……
完成了血净的龙溟内盛外虚，想要完全发挥好这一次血净的效果，他需要时间来修养，以有精力备战第二次血净。而对于你这极小概率成功的第一位龙血战士，你关心的程度也要比之前要大。
对于自己人，你向来不会吝啬，直接就将你从夺心魔手里得来，却不愿顺从你的那一件帝兵主躯级真至宝给了龙溟。
此物品质比“铸砚”还要好，真名唤作“清岚丝”……实际就是一根束发带，难得它在看你不顺后看中了龙溟，也算是为自己找了一个归属。到底是帝兵主躯级的真至宝，你还是做不到将它当做寻常至宝一样充作苍月鉴的真铸部件之一。
龙溟本就是你的龙血战士，属于你可以随意调用的力量之一，将东西给他用便也与拿在自己身上没有区别，左手倒右手的事情你谈不上心痛之说，只愿龙溟能早些提升实力，最大程度发挥出这一件帝兵主躯的全部威力，好能帮你做更多事情。】
【这也是你比较头痛的一件事情，毕竟就以龙溟现在的准帝修为，哪怕是拿着清岚丝，也只能用它的一部分力量，与人花帝境的修士掰掰手腕。
来时的路上，你让墨骨魂幡多放两只阴灵，龙溟就已经有些坚持不住。宝物终究是外物，想要强大，龙溟现在修为还太低……
重回龙穴，你尚未离开时龙阙便已经到来。而像是龙霄已死的消息，根本瞒不了她，所以你也见到了一场声嘶力竭的哭戏。
虽然你对龙霄还有些印象，记忆中与他有过一些交集。但老实说也就那样，所以你没有太多的共情。机缘这种东西本就没有那么好得，所谓“生死有命，富贵在天”便是这个道理。
成了，便可如龙溟一样扶摇直上，别说是仙帝境界修为，便是之后的三气平衡之事，你也会大力培养让他功成。没成，也就连尸骨都无，龙霄能立的只有衣冠冢。】
【匆匆瞥了一眼，眼见龙阙的身上气息平稳，想来没有与盘龙柱接触的样子，你便要离开。但也也是在你即将离开龙穴时，好巧不巧有一龙族女子进入……
龙族女子名“龙沐”，好巧不巧正是龙溟的后裔。虽然只是龙溟外曾孙女（孙女的女儿），但也是有在龙溟那里有过印象的。而以你如今与龙溟的关系，便也对此有些了解。
只是没有想到的是，上一次见没有什么奇怪地方的龙女，这一次却引起了龙衔太初冠的反应。以龙衔太初冠现在元灵都不完整的情况，让它产生反应自然没有误导的可能，只能是本能反应。
要说不同，龙沐的身上唯一不同便是有了身孕，以龙生子的漫长时间，现在这个情况也还有可能要等个数千年才成。但距离孕期也已经不短，若是你想，找到其直系先祖的龙溟，未必不可以提前探知其龙子的情况。
以你的经验，不可能猜不到这是最有可能引发龙衔太初冠变化的事情，也非常期待龙沐能够带给你这个惊喜。毕竟前一刻你还在遗憾，整个三清天龙群一脉居然连个像样的龙种都没有。】
【娃娃要从小开始培养，而为了不再出现龙阙那样的悲剧，你直接变将龙沐迷幻，带着她返回龙穴最高的一处山巅，并在这里再次迷幻了龙阙，将事情告诉给了龙溟。
龙溟见你去而复返，又得知此言，整个人高兴到手指都是颤抖的。这种样子，你在他完成血净时都不曾见……
或许龙溟与自己的外曾孙女之间有什么故事，但你还是没有要多了解的意思。而是在龙溟身上取了点东西后，便开始施展起了术法。也随着道道精纯的仙元自龙沐的身上划过，很快便见到她的脸色出现了一丝痛苦之色。
这痛苦的神色直到龙溟亲身之物接触，龙衔太初冠显化而出时才消失。而你也在耗时十余秒后得到了自己想要的答案，里面的那个孩子果真身份不小的气运，端的是一个天赋不错的龙子。
【离开前，你亲自为这位还未出生的龙子取名“龙傲”，因为他也确实有骄傲的资本。据你所观察，这至少也是一位优质变异龙种的天才，约莫有两三成可能性会是罕见的奇龙种。
变异龙种与奇龙种并不冲突，区别是后者天生便拥有一至两道天生奇异龙术。而大多数奇异龙术都是独一无二，且能够带给自身不小提升的能力。这也让他们被专门列为奇龙种，只在半神龙种之下。
以你的判断，即便只是前者，优质变异龙种在血净下的存活率也不低。且一旦成功，日后的成就也将极高，便是你最期待龙阙成为的样子……不过为了一鱼三吃，你在龙沐的身边也做了些布置。如果那盘龙柱也感应到龙族将兴，回来见龙傲，那你准备好的禁制则一定会带给他一个大大的惊喜。】
【兴致而来，兴致而归。你在离开龙穴后便去见了通天与元始，对于二人，你比对后土的信任更大，所以有关禁制之事也需两人来控制。
一方面是为了捕猎盘龙柱，另一方面则是警惕恶主。此撩虽然安生了一段时间，没有趁着你做正事时捣乱。但若是可以，你还是不希望将事情寄托在她有急事上。
而禁制无疑便是一件很好的利器，它不像是阵法一样需要操纵者的反应与魂灵都跟上，而是专门针对部分人，或部分人群进行限制。
自清明何童天、三清天与大罗天域等三处天地合为三重天外天后，此界的位阶已经不差。若再有专门的禁制布置，加上你留在这里的绿兰，与留下给她应急时使用的星陨动力舰艇，也算有些自保能力，可以拖延一些时间。】
content_en:
[Just by using the black scales, this power is already greater than the improvement from the life magic you used when you were at a low level of cultivation, and the use time of the Dragon God Void Armor is not short, enough to support you to complete a complete battle. And such a useful thing can certainly get your great attention. I wish I had a few more black scales for you to use...
After completing the blood purification, Long Ming was internally full and externally deficient. If he wanted to fully exert the effect of this blood purification, he needed time to cultivate and have the energy to prepare for the second blood purification. And for you, the first dragon-blood warrior who has a very small chance of success, you are more concerned than before.
You have never been stingy with your own people, so you directly gave Long Ming the Imperial Weapon Main Body Level True Treasure that you got from the Mind Flayer but was unwilling to obey you.
The quality of this item is even better than the "Inkstone", and its real name is "Qinglan Silk"... It's actually just a hair tie. It's rare that it fell in love with Long Ming after seeing your displeasure, and it can be regarded as finding a home for itself. After all, it is a true treasure of the main body level of the Imperial Weapon, but you still cannot treat it as an ordinary treasure and use it as one of the true cast components of the Cang Yue Jian.
Long Ming is your dragon-blooded warrior, one of the powers you can call upon at will. Giving things to him is no different from taking things on yourself. You can't say it's heartbreaking to see his left hand instead of his right. I only hope that Long Ming can improve his strength as soon as possible and maximize the full power of this imperial weapon's main body, so that he can help you do more things. 】
[This is also a headache for you. After all, with Long Ming's current quasi-emperor cultivation level, even if he holds Qinglan Silk, he can only use part of its power to compete with monks in the Human Flower Emperor Realm.
On the way here, you asked the Ink Bone Soul Banner to release two more Yin spirits, and Long Ming couldn't hold on. Treasures are foreign objects after all. If you want to be powerful, Long Ming's current cultivation level is still too low...
Return to the Dragon Cave, and the Dragon Fault has arrived before you leave. And the news that Long Xiao was dead couldn't be hidden from her at all, so you also saw a scene where she cried hoarsely.
Although you still have some impressions of Long Xiao, you have had some interactions with him in your memory. But honestly that's about it, so you don't have much empathy. Things like chance are not that easy to come by. This is the saying "life and death are destiny, wealth is in heaven".
If he succeeds, he will be able to skyrocket like Long Ming. Not to mention the cultivation of the Immortal Emperor, but also the subsequent balancing of the three qi. You will also vigorously train him to succeed. If it doesn't work, there won't even be any bones, and all Long Xiao can stand is a tomb. 】
[After a quick glance, you saw that Long Feng's aura was stable and he didn't seem to be in contact with the Panlong Pillar, so you were about to leave. But just when you were about to leave the dragon lair, a dragon woman happened to enter...
The name of a woman from the Dragon Clan is "Long Mu", and she happens to be a descendant of Long Ming. Although she was only Long Ming's great-granddaughter (granddaughter's daughter), she still had an impression of Long Ming. And based on your current relationship with Long Ming, you also have some understanding of this.
What I didn't expect was that the dragon girl who didn't have anything strange the last time she saw her would cause the dragon to hold the crown of Taichu in her mouth this time. With the dragon holding Taichu Crown and the current Yuanling intact, there is no possibility of misdirection in its reaction, it can only be an instinctive reaction.
To be different, the only difference in Long Mu's body was that she was pregnant. Considering the long time it took for Long Mu to give birth to a child, it might still take thousands of years for this situation to happen. But the pregnancy period is already quite long. If you want to find Long Ming, his direct ancestor, you may not be able to find out the status of his son in advance.
Based on your experience, it is impossible not to guess that this is the most likely thing to cause the change of Dragon Title Taichu Crown, and I very much look forward to Long Mu bringing you this surprise. After all, you were regretting just a moment ago that the entire Sanqing Tianlong group didn't even have a decent dragon species. 】
[The baby needs to be cultivated from an early age, and in order to avoid the tragedy like Long Fault, you directly transformed Long Mu into a psychedelic girl and took her back to the highest mountain top of the Dragon Cave, where you psychedelicized Long Fault again and told Long Ming what happened.
When Long Ming saw you leaving and coming back, and when he heard this, he was so happy that his fingers trembled. You have never seen this look before when he completed the blood purification...
Maybe there is some story between Long Ming and his great-granddaughter, but you still have no intention of knowing more. Instead, after taking something from Long Ming's body, he began to cast the spell. As the pure immortal essence passed through Long Mu's body, she soon saw a trace of pain on her face.
This pained look didn't disappear until Long Ming's body came into contact with him and the dragon took the Taichu Crown and appeared. And you got the answer you wanted after spending more than ten seconds. The child inside was indeed very lucky, and he was carrying a very talented dragon.
...]
[Before leaving, you personally named this unborn dragon son "Long Ao" because he is indeed proud. According to your observation, this is at least a genius of high-quality mutated dragon species, and there is about a 20 to 30% chance that he will be a rare strange dragon species.
Mutated dragon species do not conflict with strange dragon species. The difference is that the latter are born with one or two innate strange dragon skills. Most of the strange dragon arts are unique and can bring considerable improvement to one's abilities. This also allows them to be specifically classified as strange dragon species, only under the demigod dragon species.
According to your judgment, even if it is only the former, the survival rate of high-quality mutated dragon species under blood purification is not low. And once successful, your future achievements will be extremely high, which is what you most expect Long Fault to be... But in order to eat three things for one fish, you also made some arrangements around Long Mu. If the Panlongzhu also senses that the dragon clan is about to rise and comes back to see Long Ao, then the ban you prepared will definitely give him a big surprise. 】
【Come with interest and leave with interest. After you left the Dragon Cave, you went to see Tongtian and Yuanshi. You had greater trust in these two people than in Houtu, so they also needed to control matters related to the restriction.
On the one hand, it is to hunt Panlongzhu, on the other hand, it is to be wary of the evil master. Although this flirtation has been peaceful for a while, it didn't cause trouble while you were doing your business. But if possible, you still don't want to pin things on her being in an emergency.
The restriction is undoubtedly a very good weapon. It does not require the operator's reaction and soul to keep up like the formation, but specifically restricts certain people or groups of people.
Since the Qingming Dynasty, the three heavens and earth, including Hetongtian, Sanqingtian and Daluotianyu, merged into the triple heaven and the outer heaven, the rank of this world has been good. If there is a special restriction arrangement, plus the Lulan you left here, and the star-powered ship left for her to use in case of emergency, it can be considered as having some self-protection ability and can delay some time. 】
title_en: Chapter 2301 The restricted arrangement of the third level of outer heaven Chapter 2300 The real treasure in the cave
